jobs.description:
Are you an experienced heftruck driver who enjoys working in a logistics environment? Do you have warehouse experience and hold valid heftruck certificate? Then this warehouse position in Tilburg at Samsung SDS could be the perfect opportunity for you! 

You will become part of Samsung SDS, a global logistics provider delivering supply chain solutions for Samsung Electronics and a wide range of international clients. As the company continues to expand, it provides excellent opportunities for employees who are eager to grow and advance their careers. 

You are a motivated and hardworking person who is not afraid to take on a challenge. You have a positive attitude, are eager to learn, and are always to take on new tasks. You work accurately, responsibly, and safely, while staying flexible and focused on a dynamic work environment. 

- You have a valid heftruck certificate
- You have a good physical condition
- You are responsible and independent
- You are also able to work well both as part of a team and independently
- You are able to communicate in English
- You have your own means of transport to work and accommodation
- You are available to work full-time with 2 shifts 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Loading, unloading, and moving goods using a Heftruck 
- Receiving, inspecting, and registering incoming goods 
- Preparing orders and pallets for shipment 
- Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel
